decision: PHASE 4 PASSED — DOE OFFICE OF SCIENCE AWARDS ARE ISOLATED AND VERIFIED

implemented: account-free DOE Office of Science PAMS public-search reconnaissance
source-native public abstract, institution, PI, program-area, program-manager, exact award, and exact FOA search
normalized DOE Office of Science public award fields in the existing Funded Awards contract
exact DOE Office of Science FOA deep links from Funding Finder
bounded successful-response caching, source-health degradation, and independent DOE failure handling
deterministic PAMS fixtures and a bounded post-deployment exact-award smoke
explicitly_not_implemented: personal DOE/PAMS account or credential use
inferred email addresses or structured co-PIs inferred from prose
award semantic vectors or cross-source ranking

architecture_reuse.worker: The existing award Worker dispatch, per-source cache key, normalized contract, request validation, health response, CORS, and independent Promise.allSettled-style source outcomes are extended with one DOE adapter.
architecture_reuse.product: The existing Funded Awards agency control, source sections, provenance, loading, pagination, URL/history state, responsive cards, and accessibility behavior accept DOE as a third source.
architecture_reuse.funding_finder: The existing award-links eligibility boundary emits a new-tab deep link only for a controlled Office of Science record carrying an exact DE-FOA identifier.
architecture_reuse.delivery: The existing protected-main Award Worker workflow retains newest-active-version rollback, health, bounded source smoke, and Pages coherence checks.

public_access_reconnaissance.flow: GET fresh ASP.NET WebForms state, then POST the labeled public search form; dynamic __doPostBack targets page the results grid.
public_access_reconnaissance.observed_session_behavior: Fresh viewstate POSTs succeeded without a retained incoming cookie; direct public abstract GETs were account-free.
public_access_reconnaissance.rate_behavior: No 429, CAPTCHA, bot challenge, or login redirect was encountered in the bounded reconnaissance; no public rate specification was found.
public_access_reconnaissance.practical_limit: Broad search totals can be large or source-capped and PAMS response latency varies, so the product bounds results to 10 and browsing to offset 100.

production_adapter_smoke.method: One account-free all-status/all-country search per case with limit 1; no retries.

source_compliance.individual_abstract_failure: DOE metadata remains usable and source health is degraded.
source_compliance.search_contract_failure: DOE is unavailable independently; NSF and NIH results remain usable.

mapping.method: exact DE-FOA solicitation number only for controlled DOE Office of Science catalog records

known_limitations: PAMS is a public HTML/WebForms application without a published machine API or rate contract; the adapter validates known structure and fails closed if it changes.
A result without a published public abstract has only the official PAMS search surface rather than an award-specific public URL.
PAMS exposes structured lead-PI and program-manager names, but not a consistent structured co-PI field or email fields in the inspected public pages.
Program-area matching is PAMS source-native text matching and is not claimed as an exact cross-cycle program identity.
Broad PAMS search totals may be capped; the product does not claim exhaustive retrieval past its bounded browse window.
